name: Combination Discipline — Mind of the Wilds

system.description:
Prerequisites: Advanced Animalism, Advanced Auspex. Known solely to a few Phuri Dae, who use it to find safe routes of travel and camp sites, this power lets a vampire spread her awareness through local wildlife to get a general sense of conditions nearby — the presence or absence of danger, safe places and humans. It cannot determine the number or type of dangerous creatures, only give an overall impression; for specifics the Phuri Dae must summon an animal to ask or scout the area directly.

System: The player rolls Perception + Animal Ken (difficulty 8) while the vampire concentrates for a full turn. Each success grants more information over a larger area — one success might grant very general knowledge about an acre or less, while five successes could cover a mountain pass or small forest and locate the most dangerous (and safest) areas therein. A botch results in false or misleading information.

Costs 15 Experience Traits to learn.

MET: The Ravnos concentrates for one full turn without acting and wins a Static Mental Challenge (retest Animal Ken) to survey the surrounding area through the local wildlife's senses; the number of Traits bid indicates the scope of the area surveyed, at the Storyteller's discretion. This power is meant to aid scouting, not replace it outright.
system.source: Libellus Sanguinis IV: Thieves in the Night, Book One: Charlatans
